title: Custom Hooks Optimization
overview: Build composable headless logic hooks that encapsulate state machines, local storage persistence, and network polling.
Properly utilize useCallback and useMemo with rigorous dependency arrays.

takeaways.title: Referential Equality
takeaways.desc: Stabilize memoized callback signatures passed to memo-wrapped child components.

takeaways.title: Hook Composition
takeaways.desc: Assemble complex behavior from small, testable single-responsibility custom hooks.
